facts.fact: The Economist (Namibia) reports Chapter 5 and Section 20 of the Electronic Transactions Act of 2019 came into effect in June 2026.

The Economist (Namibia) reports DigiNam was launched on 31 August 2026 under the Act, with CRAN serving as Root Certification Authority tasked with accrediting certification service providers; no accreditation is yet reported.

systems.owner: CRAN as Root CA, with Ministries of Home Affairs and ICT
